firm: Yanfu Investments (上海衍复投资管理有限公司)

roles.title: 策略研究员（可实习） (Strategy Researcher, internship possible)
roles.eligibility: No graduation-year gate and no years-of-experience minimum stated. Posting adds '在校生可进行留用实习，暑期实习' (students may do a convert-to-hire or summer internship) — the full-time track is open to experienced candidates.
roles.requirements: Degree from a well-known university in maths, physics, economics or CS | Large-scale AI project experience, or behavioural-finance research, is a plus | Very strong programming/implementation ability | Team-oriented | Job scope: find patterns in historical data, build models predicting future asset prices
roles.notes: This is the closest match to the 'Quantitative Researcher' role in the existing sheet — Yanfu's public portal has no req literally titled 'Quantitative Researcher'. Posting is Chinese-only; interview and day-to-day are Mandarin-first. Onshore Shanghai entity only — a China work permit + residence permit would be needed (routine at this level but slower than HK/SG). Candidate's ICLR/AAAI papers map directly onto the 'large-scale AI project experience' plus.

roles.title: 机器学习（可实习） (Machine Learning, internship possible)
roles.eligibility: PhD required — '1.PhD毕业于知名院校的数学、物理或计算机等相关专业'. Candidate holds an MSc, so this one is gated out unless Yanfu flexes on the PhD line.
roles.requirements: PhD from a well-known university in maths, physics or CS | AI project experience in academic research, deep understanding of the underlying maths | Very strong programming/implementation ability | Team-oriented | Scope: research frontier ML algorithms and apply them to securities price prediction
roles.notes: Listed as 全职 (full-time) despite the '可实习' tag. Hard PhD gate — flagged because the rest of the profile fits well. Chinese-language posting; Mandarin required.

roles.title: 数据科学家 (Data Scientist)
roles.eligibility: '博士优先' — PhD preferred, not required. No graduation-year gate.
roles.requirements: STEM degree from a well-known Chinese or overseas university, PhD preferred | Deep understanding of model characteristics; practical model-selection and tuning ability | Familiarity with data science applied to quantitative investing (project experience preferred) | Strong self-drive, rigorous logic, collaborative | Fluent with Linux, Python and SQL for analysis and modelling
roles.notes: Python/SQL-weighted rather than C++ — a weaker fit than the ML-performance reqs below, but it sits in the research org rather than in data engineering. Mandarin required.

roles.title: 机器学习性能工程师 (Machine Learning Performance Engineer)
roles.eligibility: Bachelor's or above from a well-known Chinese/overseas university, CS-related major. No graduation-year gate and no minimum years of experience stated.
roles.requirements: Solid algorithms and maths; familiar with XGBoost/LSTM/Transformer | Proficient in Python and C++, with PyTorch/TensorFlow | Demonstrated model training or inference optimisation ability | Plus: papers at top AI conferences/journals | Plus: LLM internals, training/fine-tuning/deployment experience | Plus: Kaggle/Tianchi top-10, or core contributor to a well-known AI open-source project
roles.notes: Best single fit on the board for this candidate: the stated pluses are literally top-tier AI publications and core open-source AI contributions (llama.cpp GPU kernels), plus inference-optimisation experience. Chinese-language posting; Mandarin required. Onshore Shanghai only.

roles.title: 机器学习工程师（infra方向） (Machine Learning Engineer, Infrastructure)
roles.eligibility: Bachelor's or above, CS-related major, well-known university. No graduation-year or minimum-experience gate stated.
roles.requirements: Solid algorithms and maths; XGBoost/LSTM/Transformer | Proficient Python and C++, PyTorch/TensorFlow | Plus: CUDA, mainstream parallel programming and performance optimisation | Plus: real training/inference acceleration work | Plus: DeepSpeed, Megatron | Plus: Triton and CUTLASS, able to write efficient kernels for business needs
roles.notes: The kernel-level pluses (CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, training/inference acceleration) line up almost exactly with the candidate's llama.cpp GPU-kernel work and ISCA workshop paper. Sits alongside the ML Performance Engineer req above — likely the same team, different seniority/angle. Mandarin required.

roles.title: Quantitative Developer
roles.eligibility: No degree-level, graduation-year, or years-of-experience gate stated — the requirements are unusually short.
roles.requirements: Degree from a well-known university in maths, physics or CS | Very strong learning ability, genuine interest in both engineering and research/investment problems | Strong ownership and communication | Scope: C++ implementation and tuning of strategies | Scope: C++ trading and backtesting system development | Scope: research platform and research-data development; exploring ML across the research stack
roles.notes: Only req on the board with an English title, but the body is Chinese and there is no English-language track — treat Mandarin as required. Broadest C++ opening; the ML-exploration line makes it the closest C++/ML hybrid seat.

roles.title: 量化实现工程师 (Quantitative Implementation Engineer)
roles.eligibility: Bachelor's or above, CS-related major, well-known Chinese or overseas university. No graduation-year or minimum-experience gate.
roles.requirements: Strong command of common data structures and algorithms | Proficient in C++ | Strong business understanding, independent problem solving, teamwork | Plus: solid maths, familiar with tree models and neural networks | Plus: GPU experience or low-level library optimisation (CUDA, MKL, OpenBLAS) | Plus: ML platform tooling (k8s, kubeflow, mlflow, automl)
roles.notes: C++ seat bridging research and platform; the GPU/CUDA plus makes it a strong secondary target alongside the two ML-performance reqs. Mandarin required.

roles.title: 量化系统开发工程师 (Quantitative Systems Development Engineer)
roles.eligibility: '5年以内工作经验' — up to 5 years of experience. The candidate's ~18 months by a mid-2027 start sits inside that band; this is a cap, not a floor, and there is no student/graduation-year gate.
roles.requirements: CS degree from a well-known Chinese or overseas university | Up to 5 years' experience; big-tech or top international quant firm background preferred | Solid C/C++, algorithms and data structures | TCP/UDP network programming and IPC | Operating systems, data structures, networking fundamentals | Distributed systems, load balancing, DR and HA design; open-source contribution/reading habit preferred
roles.notes: The mid-level counterpart of the senior HFT req below — same three-line job description, different bar. Best-calibrated C++ seat for someone with under two years of production C++. Mandarin required.

roles.title: 高频系统开发工程师（资深） (Senior High-Frequency Systems Development Engineer)
roles.eligibility: '拥有3年以上超低延迟量化交易系统开发和落地相关经验' — 3+ years building and shipping ultra-low-latency quant trading systems. The candidate will have ~18 months of general production C++ and no ULL trading background, so this one is gated out.
roles.requirements: CS degree from a well-known Chinese or overseas university | Solid Linux, networking, parallel and lock-free programming | Proficient C++ including C++17/C++20 features | 3+ years ultra-low-latency quant trading system development, able to build a system independently | Fluent with performance profiling tools
roles.notes: Listed for completeness — the experience floor is a real gate. Apply to the non-senior 量化系统开发工程师 instead. Mandarin required.

roles.title: 数据开发工程师 (Data Development Engineer)
roles.eligibility: Bachelor's or above in CS, software engineering, maths or financial engineering. No graduation-year or minimum-experience gate.
roles.requirements: Proficient in at least one of Python / Java / C++ / Go | Solid CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, OS, networking, databases | Relational databases and SQL; data modelling, cleaning, validation | Strong independent debugging of complex engineering problems | Plus: data platform, ETL, warehouse, scheduling experience (Airflow, Dagster, Temporal, Spark, Flink, Kafka, ClickHouse) | Plus: financial/market/trade/alternative data experience
roles.notes: Marginal for this candidate — it is a data-platform/ETL seat rather than trading-systems C++, and the language list is polyglot. Included because C++ is explicitly named and it is core research infrastructure, but rank it below the other four C++ reqs. Mandarin required.

existing_rows_audit.detail: The Shanghai office is real and confirmed twice — AMAC registry lists 上海衍复投资管理有限公司, manager no. P1070325, registered 2019-11-11, office address 上海市徐汇区瑞平路275号保利西岸C座7楼 (https://gs.amac.org.cn/amac-infodisc/res/pof/manager/index.html), matching the address on the firm's own site. A research req is genuinely open, but no posting is titled 'Quantitative Researcher'; the live equivalent is 策略研究员（可实习）(Strategy Researcher) at https://yanfu.jobs.feishu.cn/index/position/7631023009179928875/detail. Two further problems with the row: the Source/Verify URL 'http://www.yanfuinvest.com/' is not Yanfu's domain (the real site is https://yanfuinvestments.com and the job board is https://yanfu.jobs.feishu.cn/index), and the '¥600k–1.2M' comp figure is not stated on any Yanfu posting or primary source I could reach — treat it as unverified. The 'tiny headcount' rationale is also dated: Wikipedia cites 68 employees and US$7.7bn AUM as of June 2024. The 'Mandarin required' note in the row is correct and, if anything, understated — the entire job board is Chinese-only.

notes:
Careers coverage: Yanfu runs its live job board on Feishu/Lark at https://yanfu.jobs.feishu.cn/index (reached from the 浏览职位 button on https://yanfuinvestments.com/join). The board is a client-rendered SPA and its job-search API returns 405 to plain HTTP clients, so I rendered it in headless Chrome to enumerate reqs; every URL above was loaded and read individually. 19 reqs were live on 2026-08-04, all tagged 上海 (Shanghai) — the board's own city filter offers Shanghai and nothing else. The 9 reqs I did not list are out of scope: 4 internships (销售支持实习, AI agent 开发工程师（可实习）, C++开发实习生, 数据工程开发实习生 — the data one states 3-months-plus, under the 6-month bar), 高级网络工程师 (low-latency trading network engineering, not one of the four tracks, though it is the most adjacent of the excluded set), 基金运营专员（网下打新方向）, 招聘岗（quant方向）, and two 综合管理专员 admin roles.

A stale Beisen recruitment portal also exists at https://yanfuinvestments1.zhiye.com/ but its job API returns zero live reqs — the Feishu board has superseded it. Do not use it.

Offices: Shanghai (Xuhui district) is the only in-scope office, confirmed against both the firm's own site and the AMAC registry. The firm's site mentions a Beijing office opened in 2026 and a 青金计划 3.0 summer internship running in Shanghai and Beijing (applications 13–31 March 2026, now closed) — Beijing is out of scope for this sheet and is a student-gated programme anyway. I found no evidence of a Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo or European entity: the AMAC search for '衍复' returns exactly one manager, Wikipedia's article mentions no offshore arm, and a targeted search for an SFC-licensed Yanfu entity turned up nothing. Treat this as an onshore-only, Shanghai-only manager.

Mandarin: every posting body is in Chinese, including the one with an English title (Quantitative Developer). The corporate site has a 中/EN toggle but the Feishu careers portal is Chinese-only, and the application form is Chinese-only. There is no evidence of an English-tolerant track. A mainland China work and residence permit would be required — routine at these comp levels but slower than a Hong Kong or Singapore package.

Compensation: no Yanfu posting states a salary band, and the Feishu job schema's 月薪范围 field is not displayed publicly. Aggregator listings (liepin, nowcoder) quote figures like ¥30k–60k/month with 15–18 months for a strategy researcher, but I could not tie those to a Yanfu-controlled source, so every comp_local is left empty.

Application route: apply through the Feishu portal directly, or email hr@yanfuinvestments.com (the address given on both the firm's site and its recruitment posts). The firm also runs a year-round 'Max α' senior-hire programme advertised on its own site as offering industry-leading compensation, with no posted band.
